source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of privacy and security threats (PDF 179).

blocks.text: Aaj ki digital duniya mein privacy aur security ke khatre (threats) aam hain, aur yeh individuals (aam log) aur organizations (idare, jaise company ya bank) dono par asar dalte hain. Yeh khatre personal maloomat, financial data (paise se jura data) aur poori online security ko compromise (khatre mein daal kar nuqsan) kar sakte hain. In khatron ko achhi tarah samajhna zaroori hai ta ke ho sakne wale nuqsan se bacha ja sake aur sensitive (nijji aur qeemti) maloomat mehfooz rahe. Privacy aur security ke khatron ki kuch bari qismein hain, jo agle hisson mein hain.

blocks.prompt: Security threats kin teen cheezon ko khatre mein daal sakte hain?
blocks.explanation: Personal maloomat, financial data (paise se jura data) aur poori online security.

items: Privacy aur security threats aam logon aur organizations dono ki personal maloomat, financial data aur online security ko khatre mein dalte hain; inhein samajhna hifazat ka pehla qadam hai.
